sources.label: Official John Lewis size chart (own-brand womenswear, product page)
Same chart on a second John Lewis top

audit: Old guide URL shows an empty page. Chart read from the Size chart panel on two John Lewis own-brand tops (identical). Letters were wrong: old M (UK 12) 91/71/96 now 12 92/75/100; old XL (UK 16) 102/82/107 now 16 104/87/112 (XL is 20: 116/99/124). Letter row in altLabel as printed in the second table. US/EU removed (not printed). Applies to John Lewis own brand only; other brands sold there have their own charts.
